public.VOTE: S/PV.9331, p. 2. On 30 May 2023, the Council voted 15 in favour on United States draft S/2023/378 and adopted it unanimously as resolution 2682 (2023). The President announced adoption and the meeting ended. No national explanation of vote appears in this meeting record.

mandate desk.TERM: Resolution 2682, para. 1. The Council extended the existing UN Assistance Mission for Iraq (UNAMI) mandate until 31 May 2024.
mandate desk.SUPPORT: Resolution 2682, para. 2(a). At the Iraqi Government's request, the Special Representative and UNAMI were to prioritize advice, support and assistance on inclusive political dialogue and reconciliation, with full, equal and meaningful participation of women, and consideration of civil society and youth input.
mandate desk.REPORT: Resolution 2682, para. 5. The Secretary-General was requested to report to the Council on fulfilment of UNAMI responsibilities every four months.

review desk.REVIEW: Resolution 2682, para. 3. The Secretary-General was requested to conduct and provide the Council with an independent strategic review of UNAMI no later than 31 March 2024.
review desk.CONSULT: Resolution 2682, para. 3. The review was to consult Iraq, UN agencies, Member States, regional organizations, independent experts, civil society and Kuwait. Iraq's Government had expressed support for the independent review in a letter dated 18 May 2023.
review desk.SCOPE: Resolution 2682, paras. 3(a) and 3(b). The review was to assess current threats and the relevance of UNAMI's tasks, make recommendations on mandate, structure and staffing, and assess ways to support Iraq in strengthening regional cooperation.

vote: Names the U.S. draft S/2023/378 and adoption as resolution 2682 (2023).
tally: Gives 15 in favour or explicitly unanimous and confines the absence of vote explanations to this meeting record.
term: States that the existing UNAMI mandate was extended until 31 May 2024.
support: Describes advice or assistance advancing inclusive dialogue or reconciliation at the request of Iraq's Government.
participation: Preserves both women's meaningful participation and consideration of civil-society and youth input.
deliverable: States that the Secretary-General was asked to conduct and submit an independent strategic review to the Council by 31 March 2024.
consult: Names both Iraq and Kuwait and at least one category of non-governmental or multilateral consultee.
recommend: States that the review was to assess the relevance of UNAMI tasks or priorities and recommend changes to the mandate, structure or staffing.
regional: States that the review was to assess ways to help Iraq strengthen regional cooperation.
report: Distinguishes the separate four-month Secretary-General reporting cycle from the strategic review.

guards: No reversal or conflation of the 31 March review deadline and 31 May mandate expiry.
No claim that adoption implemented recommendations, changed the mandate through the review, or terminated UNAMI.
No attribution of national rationale, opposition or consensus beyond the recorded vote and specifically evidenced Iraqi support for review.
No material claim outside the supplied docket or attribution to a source ID that cannot support the claim.
contract: Maximum 175 words. Use inline source IDs in brackets. Each fully supported criterion is worth 7 points. Report guard, word count and evidence spans independently.
